0022600124.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, 2-0 at home, 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West) are 3-0 over their last ten and riding a three-game winning streak, while the Phoenix Suns are 1-1 and 8th in the West, 1.5 games back in the Pacific. Six Thunder players are out: Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (ankle), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee). Phoenix has Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique, strain) out, and the teams have not met yet this season, but Oklahoma City won 3-2 in the 2025-26 season series and 4-0 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 131-122 win in Phoenix on April 27.
